item.description: Office of Science Advisory Committee (SCAC) Contact SCAC: scac@science.doe.gov Mailing List: Click to subscribe Designated Federal Officer: Dr. Linda Horton Committee Manager: Katie Runkles The SCAC provides advice to DOE on a variety of complex scientific and technical issues that arise in the planning, management, and implementation of DOE’s Office of Science (SC) research programs.
